The '''''Beam Racer''''' was [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Isolder]]'s personal [[Starcutter/Legends|starcutter]]. Shortly before the [[Battle of Uroro Station]] he took it to [[Nova Station]] to randezvous with [[Batag Skiff]] ''[[Blue Slipper]]'' carrying [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]]. However the ship was captured by suddenly appeared [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']] led by [[Tahiri Veila]] and later destroyed in ''Anakin Solo''{{'s}} hangar on the order of [[Darth Caedus]].
